path extrema ignore ordering / path of extrema
SIDE still depends on previous 24h return
high RV may proxy for other states
target-specific PATH_SCALE<=0 rows are excluded from the new estimand only

ADVERSE_SHARE removes common same-path amplitude scaling but not every possible volatility-related shape effect
ANTI_TAUTOLOGY.WHY_ADVERSE_SHARE_IS_DIFFERENT: ADVERSE_SHARE divides MAE_SIDE by the same-path two-sided envelope MAE_SIDE+MAE_OPPOSITE, so uniform amplitude inflation cancels. It asks whether the path is disproportionately adverse relative to its own opposite-side excursion.
ANTI_TAUTOLOGY.WHY_MAE_SIDE_CAN_RISE_WITH_PATH_SCALE: arithmetic_mae is a one-sided amplitude. If the whole future path scales up, both adverse and favorable extrema grow, so MAE_SIDE can increase even when orientation is unchanged.

CLASSIFICATION_RULES.D2_DECOMPOSITION_NO_USEFUL_STRUCTURE: else: primary all-gates fail AND PATH_SCALE not materially elevated
CLASSIFICATION_RULES.D2_EXCESS_DIRECTION_ALIGNED_PATH_RISK_PR: else if STATISTICAL_GATE and PRACTICAL_GATE and TEMPORAL_GATE
CLASSIFICATION_RULES.D2_VOLATILITY_SCALE_COMPATIBLE_NO_EXCESS: else if PATH_SCALE_MATERIALLY_ELEVATED: no ROBUST excess alignment under the frozen all-gates rule; not proof that excess alignment is absent

PRIMARY_QUANTITIES.MU_SHARE_RULE: mean ADVERSE_SHARE on D2-abstained target-eligible rows

SCIENTIFIC_QUESTION: Within the same calendar year and the same frozen D2 SIDE, does RULE_1 RV_ABSTENTION select days whose subsequent 24h path allocates a larger share of two-sided excursion against that side than year×SIDE-matched rate-matched random dates, after removing simple total path-scale inflation?

SELECTOR_CONTRACT.ABSTAIN_RULE: ABSTAIN(t)=1 iff RV_BTC_24H(t) > P90 of previous 250 valid constructed-row RV observations; t excluded; strict >
SELECTOR_CONTRACT.BTC_RET_24H: frozen btc_ret_24h at feature cutoff E=T-5m

TEMPORAL_GATE: DELTA_SHARE > 0 in at least 3 of 5 years 2020-2024
WHY_SIDE_MATCHING: SIDE is frozen pre-decision sign(BTC_RET_24H). The selector remains RV_ABSTENTION only, but high-RV rows may have different LONG/SHORT composition. Year-only matching could confound a high-RV state effect with SIDE composition × unconditional directional market asymmetry. Year×SIDE matching asks whether, within the same year and same frozen exposure direction, the high-RV selector identifies paths with larger adverse share. This does not change the selector, SIDE, target, or condition on future information.
